description: Emulate browser conditions over CDP: network throttling (Slow 3G, Fast 3G, 4G, Offline), CPU throttling rate, Geolocation coordinates, Timezone, and User Agent string overrides.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

cpuThrottlingRate.description: CPU slowdown multiplier (e.g. 2 = 2x slowdown, 4 = 4x slowdown, 1 = disable)

network.description: Network throttling profile or custom parameters

name: browser_emulate
